g.text: Not every model traverses every edge — a useful representation may stay advisory.
Legend — notation used throughout Appendix C
AUTHORED — solid arrow = a declared relation (authored intent)
DERIVED · OBSERVED — dashed arrow = derived / observed correspondence
CHECKED — heavy boundary + gate glyph = real authority (can block)
Boxes denote representations. Meaning is encoded by line style, weight, and glyph — not colour.
